finding: Purchase charge is not covered by the gifts.idempotency_key unique index; a retried purchase_gift runs the stub/Stripe charge before the insert collides on the constraint, so a double-submit can charge twice. The current charge-then-insert ordering also blocks clean Phase-2 Stripe separation.
fix: Sequence the charge after a successful gift insert and pass idempotency_key into the Billing.Provider charge callback so the provider dedupes; do not rely on the row unique index to dedupe money.

finding: Charge-vs-Multi ordering is unspecified (effect inside transaction vs before it), and reviews is denormalized from pack_key with no consistency guarantee while the terminal grant trusts reviews.
fix: State charge ordering (charge in shell after insert, idempotent on key); derive reviews from pack_key at insert and validate in the changeset (CHECK or derive-at-grant).

finding: Redeem (expires_at>now) vs expiry cron (expires_at<now) leaves a cron-lag window where a gift is redeemable past its stated 5yr window until the daily sweep; Regenerate is a guarded :pending self-loop not shown on the diagram. No grant-doubling (status==:pending+FOR UPDATE holds), but the hard-window claim and the rescue path are under-documented.
fix: Document cron-lag slack or flip lagging-expired gifts to :expired on redeem; add Regenerate to the diagram as a guarded :pending self-loop serialized via FOR UPDATE.

section: Flow A step 4/5, Flow D, edge cases
finding: Internal contradiction: token shown once and 'never recoverable from replay' but the purchase confirmation email contains the live claim link, so the plaintext token sits in the giver's mailbox. Reconnect mount-from-DB path for the sent-gifts list is implied but not stated.
fix: Pick a token-durability model (email link as giver system-of-record, Regenerate for 'lost email too'), drop the 'never recoverable' framing, and state mount restores sent-gifts from DB not socket assigns.

finding: Single-terminal-grant invariant holds: every terminal transition is status==:pending-guarded under FOR UPDATE; escrow-via-record keeps the ledger append-only.
fix: None; ensure redeem and expiry both re-check status==:pending inside the FOR UPDATE tx (already specified).

finding: Bounded batched Oban Cron worker with FOR UPDATE re-check is correct; re-enqueue should be an explicit Oban.insert and the worker a unique job to avoid overlapping sweeps.
fix: Make GiftExpiryWorker a unique job; re-enqueue via Oban.insert rather than in-process recursion.

finding: No vendor leak into Gifts; charge via Billing public API. Provider charge callback must carry idempotency_key so Phase-2 Stripe can dedupe.
fix: Add idempotency_key to the Billing.Provider charge @callback signature now.

finding: Clean new Gifts context via public APIs and by-ID refs. The 'additive metadata arity on Credits.grant' is claimed zero-risk; if grant does not already accept metadata:+dedup it is a prerequisite Credits change.
fix: Verify Credits.grant supports metadata: with dedup key before build; otherwise treat as a dependency.

finding: crypto/Base stdlib usage correct. Purchase/redeem telemetry registered but expiry worker and redeem-failure paths have no metrics despite being the new async surface.
fix: Add [:perfect_paper,:gifts,:expired] telemetry (batch size/grant count/duration) and a redeem-failure counter.

finding: Sent-gifts list grows and mutates but is not specified as a LiveView stream.
fix: Render the sent-gifts list with phx-update=stream.

finding: Partial index where status='pending', nilify_all FKs, hashed code_hash unique index are sound for a new (empty) table. Note: enum has no DB-level default and reviews/pack_key consistency is unconstrained.
fix: Set status default :pending in the changeset (or column default), consider a CHECK tying reviews to pack_key.

finding: CONVERGED — prior 1 Critical + 3 Major all resolved and verified against source (credits.ex grant/4 fixed-arity + private dedup path; billing.ex purchase_pack fuses resolve_charge+grant; provider.ex has no charge callback). Rev 2 adds dedup-capable Credits.grant prerequisite, Billing.charge_gift charge-without-grant port at forced Band A, charge-in-shell-after-insert with idempotency_key to provider, reviews derived+CHECK, redeem-time window enforcement, email-as-system-of-record, unique Oban expiry job, phx-update=stream, gift.* event + telemetry registration.
fix: Plan must actually add gift.* atoms to Events.Event @types + metrics to Telemetry.metrics/0; new Provider charge @callback must carry idempotency_key.
